# Pippa Manicom — Registered Dietitian, Constantia, Cape Town

> A private dietetics practice on Willow Road, Constantia, serving Cape Town's
> Southern Suburbs in person and the rest of South Africa online. Registered
> with the HPCSA (DT0019429). No doctor's referral is needed to book.

## Practitioner

Pippa Manicom is a registered dietitian with more than 20 years of clinical and
corporate experience. She qualified at the University of Cape Town with a BSc in
Human Physiology and Psychology and a BSc (Med)(Hons) in Nutrition & Dietetics,
and holds a Diploma in Exercise & Fitness Studies from the Exercise Teachers
Academy.

She spent four years in London hospitals (Guy's & St Thomas', Kingston Hospital,
Epsom & St Helier), then ran a private practice at a Sports Injury Clinic in
Johannesburg, consulted to corporates including executives at Exec Care, and in
2023 moved her practice to Constantia, Cape Town.

Registrations: Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA, DT0019429);
Board of Healthcare Funders (practice number 084 00 00 197 971); Association of
Dietetics in South Africa (ADSA, Gauteng South and Western Cape).

## Services and fees (ZAR)

- Initial consultation, 60 minutes — R750. Medical history, symptoms, recent
  blood results, current eating habits, lifestyle, activity levels, supplements
  and anthropometry (height, weight, body fat %); goals are set.
- Second consultation, 60–90 minutes — R880. Eating plan and booklet, plus
  nutrition education covering healthy eating guidelines and portion control.
- Follow-up consultation, 30 minutes — R400. Progress check, weight and body
  fat % monitoring, questions.
- Vitality nutrition assessment, 45 minutes — R520. Quick assessment of the
  current diet with a few key points to improve. Earns 1000 Vitality points.
  Does not include an individualised meal plan.
- Corporate wellness — one-on-one consultations in the office, onsite Vitality
  nutrition assessments, wellness days, smoothie demonstrations, healthy lunch
  and snack demonstrations, talks and presentations to staff.
- Nutrition talks and presentations — for primary and high school students,
  university students and older adults, on healthy balanced eating.

Consultations are available in person in Constantia or online by video call
anywhere in South Africa.

## Conditions treated

Weight management (loss or gain); type 2 diabetes and insulin resistance;
cholesterol; high blood pressure; arthritis and gout; fibromyalgia and chronic
fatigue syndrome; IBS, heartburn/reflux and constipation; pregnancy and
breastfeeding; menopause; sports nutrition.

## Areas served

Based on Willow Road, Constantia, Cape Town, Western Cape, 7806. Clients are
seen in person from Constantia, Tokai, Bishopscourt, Meadowridge, Wynberg,
Claremont, Kenilworth, Newlands, Rondebosch, Plumstead, Bergvliet,
Kirstenbosch, Muizenberg, Hout Bay and Cape Town CBD. Online consultations are
available nationwide.

## Common questions

Do I need a doctor's referral to see a dietitian in Cape Town? No. You can book
a private consultation directly.

Are online consultations available? Yes, in person at Willow Road, Constantia,
or online by video call anywhere in South Africa.

Is Pippa Manicom a registered dietitian? Yes, registered with the HPCSA
(membership number DT0019429) and a member of ADSA.

How do I book? Use the contact form at https://pippamanicom.co.za/, WhatsApp or
call 084 616 7000, or email pippamanicom@gmail.com.
